confidence_notes: Summary-only document: no Transcript section and no dialogue anywhere, so every field here rests on Gemini's third-person narration and all provenance is summary_narration. Not one prospect utterance is recorded, which is why prospect_next_move on the only objection is null (rule 2) and why prospect_questions is null rather than an empty array - a live demo of this length certainly drew questions, but none are attributed in the notes, so zero cannot be asserted. The account is never named: Highland Creek Golf Club is only the course the rep dialled for the demo (rule 8), so account_name is null and account_source is unresolved. The notes refer to both a 'golf course owner' and a 'restaurant owner' in the next steps, which may be the same person at a course with a restaurant, but the facility is not identified either way. The single objection needs a caveat: the notes establish that the decision sits with an absent owner and that the rep built material for that person, but they never record the prospect raising it as a concern, so this is an approval-authority constraint evidenced by narration rather than a voiced objection. Two other candidates were deliberately not coded as objections: whether GolfNow would push back on the integration appears only as a rep research item with the concern attributed to no one, and the roughly $5 per month extra phone line appears as a rep clarification, not as prospect resistance - both are recorded under unanswered_questions instead. post_demo sentiment is null because no reaction to the demonstration is recorded; the Details bullets are topical rather than reliably chronological, so nothing following the demo bullet can be read as a response to it, and call_path follows that same bullet order and should be treated as approximate.
